name: mix, incubate, wash on demo_small_c3
source: Assay from md: tests/fixtures/demo_bead_wash.md (sha256 44feedfb34f7); grouped into unit operations by assay2chip S1-S4. Chip geometry, volumes and flows are ours, from demo_small_c3.
description: Runs on chip/demo_small_c3.json: mix, incubate, wash, in 2 steps and about 0.1 h. Generated by assay2chip S8 (s8_protocol) from the unit operations of 'demo_small'; nothing numeric about liquid is typed into the generator. VOLUMES are multiples of the volume_ul of the chamber each step runs in (incubate_5 1.3333 uL), and an exchange moves at most one chamber volume per wash. EXCHANGES declare what they are for: a sweep moves 4.61 chamber volumes, which is -ln(1 - exchange.target_fraction) at 99%, because a well-mixed chamber keeps exp(-V) of the old liquid after V chamber volumes; a fill is bounded above by the chamber volume; a partial states the fraction it replaces. FLOWS are derived per chamber from tau = 6*mu*Q/(w*h^2) on the real cross-section of the channel the liquid crosses - never a bounding box - at 85% of whichever ceiling is scoped to what that chamber holds, and every flow is also held under capsule.escape_pressure_kpa x control.pressure_margin over the whole route. Capsule handling has no wall-shear ceiling at all: pressure is its limit. DURATIONS are volume x washes / flow plus 25% for pump ramp, line dead volume and settling. REAGENT NAMES are generic placeholders from a closed vocabulary and are not a recipe; no concentration, vendor or enzyme name from the source reaches this file (CONFIDENTIALITY.md). RESTS ON CONTRACT ASSUMPTIONS (not published numbers): capsule.escape_pressure_kpa, control.pressure_margin, fluid.viscosity_37c_pa_s. GAPS, carried from the ops rather than filled in: op 4: S6 realised this 'mix' AS A CHANNEL rather than as a part of its own, and the protocol contract can only target a chamber or a port: the stream performs it while flowing to the next chamber, and the channel's own length is what makes it happen, so no separate step was written.

steps.note: Hold 'incubate_5' at 20 C for 5 min at 20 C with every port capped, in thermal zone 'incubate_5_zone', which is rated to 20 C (the spec states no floor for it). No flow during the hold.

Fill 'incubate_5' with wash_buffer through 'reagent_in'. one chamber volume, 1.333 uL: a fill cannot put in more than the chamber holds, and the source's own volume is a tube volume that does not transfer. 677.6 uL/min keeps the predicted drop over the whole route at or below 3.5 kPa across the route (capsule.escape_pressure_kpa x control.pressure_margin) (3.50 kPa at this flow, resistance 0.005 kPa per uL/min), using the folded channel's own width (0.2 mm), not the 3.2037 x 3.2 mm bounding box of the part. Duration is volume x washes / flow plus 25% for pump ramp, line dead volume and settling.
